author: Rtx0
quote: The one point is for the art. everything else is a huge letdown. The game is a buggy mess. I've had glitches, crashes, and missions breaking on me mid-objective, forcing restarts. After 13 years of development, this is the polish we get? And when it does work, the story gives you no reason to care. Jason and Lucia are flat, the plot is predictable, and every mission is the same drive, shoot, cutscene loop Rockstar has been recycling for years. I was bored long before the credits.Gorgeous to look at, miserable to play.
